description: Use this when the user asks about a booking they already made, or to check whether the payment of a booking just created went through. Needs the booking code (PRV-YYYY-NNNN) and the email used to book. Returns the booking status and where the payment stands (stage: pending, card_saved, held, paid or cancelled). It never returns amounts or payment links.
name: get_booking_status
title: PRIVYDE · booking status
